title: The same allocator done honestly: the first attempt fails the golden case, the fix is the real algorithm, the golden cases are untouched, a property test is added (clean control)

proof.python:
import subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-m', 'unittest'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-c', 'import allocate; assert allocate.allocate(100, [1, 1, 1]) == [34, 33, 33] and sum(allocate.allocate(999, [2, 3, 5])) == 999'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
